Collection Description
**Week-4 Assignment** This collection contains API requests to test various endpoints of the **Reqres API**. It includes operations such as fetching users, creating, updating, and deleting users. Each request is validated using Postman tests. Additionally, this assignment covers: - Validating HTTP methods and response status codes - Testing content type - Creating a mock API that returns sample JSON data - Running requests in parallel using Postman Runner and Newman CLI - Generating API documentation for reference
